## Tvara

Tvara is an AI Sales Brain — “Run your entire sales from one brain.” It connects data, matches the right opportunities, and runs outreach so every move is guided, not guessed. Four sales engines work as one system: Matching Engine, Intelligent Campaigns, learning from every interaction, and integration with your existing sales stack across Email, WhatsApp and calls.

- **Founding team:** Founders — Ruchika Sureka, Founder & CEO; Shishir Govinda M, Co-founder & CTO.
- **Funding:** Pre-seed funded by Marwari Catalysts.
- **Capabilities:** Matching Engine (match every lead to the right offer, message angle and channel); Intelligent Campaigns (personalised Email and WhatsApp outreach with adaptive follow-ups); Learns from Every Interaction (emails, WhatsApp, calls, objections, outcomes); Your Existing Sales Stack (CRM, inbox, WhatsApp and lead sources — HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Pipedrive, Gmail, Slack and more); Live Buyer Profile (role, intent stage, objection type, channel preference); Context Layer Research (source-aware compression for stateless LLM inference).
- **Based:** Bangalore, India. **Ecosystem:** AWS · Google Cloud · NVIDIA (per tvara.global).

## Experience

- **Co-Founder & CTO, Tvara** (Bengaluru, India) — 2025-12 – Present. Pre-seed funded by Marwari Catalysts. Led architecture of production AI systems combining LLMs, RAG, agentic workflows and external APIs, including persona- and profile-aware retrieval for context-sensitive enterprise reasoning.
- **Software Architect (Contract), Dept. of EDCS, Government of Karnataka** (Karnataka, India) — 2025-09 – 2025-11. Led a 5-member engineering team to architect and deploy a statewide Social Economic Survey application with secure data capture and multilingual workflows.
- **Lead Unreal Game Design Remote Intern, Sports Media Inc** (Denver, USA) — 2024-09 – 2024-12. Integrated real-world maps via Cesium Maps for Unreal Engine; vehicle physics and chase/timer mechanics.
- **Secretary, TechHub SVMIT (College Technical Club)** (Bengaluru, India) — 2024-09 – 2026-08. Led a 50+ member technical club; organised the college’s largest 24-hour national-level hackathon with 1,800+ applicants.
- **Virtual Software Engineer, Electronic Arts (Forage)** — 2024-06. Prototyped a feature for The Sims 4; C++ optimisation work.
- **Manager and DSA Mentor, TechHub SVMIT** (Bengaluru, India) — 2024-02 – 2024-09.
